title: PICERL Incident Response Lifecycle
description: Mermaid flowchart of the six PICERL incident-response phases as a closed loop, with a dashed feedback arrow from Lessons Learned back to Preparation and typical time labels per phase.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Name the six PICERL phases in order and explain what happens in each.
Identify Containment as the most time-critical phase.
Describe how the Lessons Learned to Preparation feedback loop improves future response.
educational.prerequisites: Basic familiarity with what a security incident is.

controls: Read the six phases left to right
Follow the dashed feedback arrow from Lessons Learned back to Preparation
Read each phase's typical time/effort label
pedagogical.assessment: Students walk a tabletop scenario through all six phases, naming the action and rough duration for each.
misconceptionsAddressed: Treating incident response as a one-time checklist rather than a repeating lifecycle.
Starting Recovery before Eradication is complete.
